name: vc-deal-flow-signal
description: Track startup engineering acceleration from public GitHub data. Returns trending startups, sector signals, and per-company velocity profiles across 20 sectors. Updated weekly. Free, no auth.

tools.name: get_trending_startups
tools.description: Top 20 startups by engineering acceleration across all 20 sectors for the current weekly period.

tools.name: search_startups_by_sector
tools.description: Every tracked startup within a sector, ranked by engineering acceleration. Sector slug must be one of 20 enumerated values.

tools.name: get_startup_signal
tools.description: Full engineering-acceleration profile for a single tracked startup, by display name or GitHub org slug. Case-insensitive.

tools.name: get_signals_summary
tools.description: High-level snapshot of the dataset: period, sector and startup counts, last refresh, citation, and direct URLs to JSON/CSV/RSS/OpenAPI/llms.txt.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Full methodology behind the signal: data sources, metric computation, signal classification thresholds, refresh cadence, and known limitations.
